summary: Regression testing after business-details content correction. Additional live /api/chat checks confirmed real content: 'Tell me about personal tax' -> canvas.view='service' with 'Personal Tax' title and real features; 'Who would I work with?' -> canvas.view='team' with advisor='Oliver Grills', role='Principal, Chartered Accountant'. Advice.' + proposition 'Accounting support that scales…'; hero-book-call links to https://calendly.com/olivergrills/discovery-call in a new tab; phone 01704 500299 visible; STATS render as word badges Cloud-first / Proactive / UK-wide / Advisers; work-with-0/1/2 render; all 6 home-service-* testids present (personal-tax, business-tax, payroll, business-formation, bookkeeping, fca-sra-compliance); NO case-study-* or testimonial-* elements; NO 'Est. 1979' or '£40m'. About page shows Oliver Grills as Principal only (no John/David/Claire, no 'Est. 1979', no 'Founded in undefined'). Contact page shows address 40 Hoghton Street, phone 01704 500299, advisor phone 07976 133339, hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, contact-book-call linking to Calendly, and no email info card; contact form submitted to /api/contact successfully ('Message sent'). AI mode greeting on /ai references real services (personal tax, business accounts & tax, payroll, bookkeeping, business formation and FCA/SRA compliance). Only console noise observed: two 401s on /api/auth/me for logged-out users — expected and documented as non-bug.
